en-US.title: ClawPool - Personal AI
en-US.subtitle: Your personal AI assistant
en-US.description:
ClawPool gives you your very own personal AI assistant — always available, always learning, just for you.

Powered by Google Gemini, your AI can:
• Answer any question
• Help write emails and content
• Assist with coding and research
• Remember your preferences

Each user gets their own dedicated AI instance — completely private.

Free trial included. Subscribe for unlimited access.

review.notes: This is an AI chat app. No special credentials needed. Register with any email to test.
